edits.after: Conversely, emphasizing equal dignity cannot require an organization to ignore real differences in ability and responsibility. Equal respect is not identical evaluation. edits.before: It is as though the income result were enough to judge the entire path. Yet life changes. Low-paid learning may later open a new direction; a high-income job may cease to be worthwhile at a certain stage. Today's price cannot close the future's case.
